bodyDescription: This delicious jelly treat made with chicken and vegetables is a veritable delicacy for every cat!The natural ingredients are steamed so that the nutritious properties are well preserved. Cleaning and preparing the chicken, filling cans and adding toppings are all done manually. This delicious gluten-free chicken-based jelly treat is a real treat for any cat !
